caption: Fig. 1 Schematic illustration of the conformality analysis with LHAR channels: (a) uncoated channel, (b) channel after ALD coating, and (c) channel after removing the roof and exposing the surface for analysis. H is the height and L the length of the LHAR channel. The illustration is intentionally not in scale: typical aspect ratios L : H in LHAR structures are at least 200:1 and the ratios in this work are typically up to 10 000 : 1.
